reviews.title: Home station not supported

reviews.title: Ad-free in In App Purchases, not in app
reviews.text:
The App Store indicates $1.99 for a year of ads free. App indicates $19.99 for Premium, which is required to go ad-free. Lame.  Now you get nothing. Extra disappointing since I am contributing to WU with my station, and no longer get ad-free since 2023?

On the plus side, glad they haven’t bowed down to the maga cult tyranny with lake name changes. This will be changed back, and hopefully not allowed to be changed again without 2/3 of house and senate, based on support from the majority of people, not King-like behavior no one asked for, and a waste of spend to try to stray away from what really matters.

reviews.title: Really Off

reviews.title: Barometric Pressure
reviews.text: Barometric pressure does not appear on app and apparently cannot be added (you can only see it if you go to their website) !  I attempted to use app support but no info there.  Chatbot it is only available for support if you agree to your data being used throughout their vendor base.  Google search claims it is included however the actual app; as well as the screen shots in the App Store, clearly show that it is not. You clearly have the data - why can’t we see it. I will be happy to update this review if someone can show me how to display barometric pressure on the app.

reviews.title: Inaccurate
reviews.text: Over the last year this app has become completely inaccurate. Obviously this app is using an AI model to run its predictions and has gone from one of the best to one of the worst. Two day predictions used to be very accurate but now it changes hour to hour. Delete.

reviews.title: A Mislabeled Random Number Generator
reviews.text:
I cannot tell you the number of times that their precipitation estimates have been off by a FACTOR OF 10! Not days in the future. No, that would be an excusable occasional error. Just hours away, and they are so ridiculously wrong. I would hope that people get fired over things like that, but they seem to get promoted.

They just changed my rain forecast for the next few hours from 2.70 inches to 0.01 inches. Nice to have a 270X error range. This app would be better as a random number generator.

reviews.title: App permits scams which con money from vulnerable people, especially harming senior citizens.
reviews.text: This app may work but they allow phony scam advertisements to run on their platform. These ad’s are run by known criminals outside the US often charging hundreds of dollars for fake non functional a/c units.  Worse yet, they will contact the buyer and falsely claim the credit card charge failed and attempt to double charge.  The owners of this app are well aware of this scam and have knowingly allow this to continue for years.

reviews.title: Used to be good
reviews.text: I’m kind of heartbroken writing this review. I have been using Wunderground before smartphones. I’m talking since like 2002 when I was only available on the computer. I’ve been loyal to Wunderground for almost 25 years. However, I’ve noticed lately, the app has been SO inaccurate! The forecasting has been so off. We will be estimated to get storms, then nothing happens, or vise versa. My last draw is last night we were predicted to get rain from midnight to 7am only. However, at 11:45am, Wunderground was still reporting 100% rain, yet the radar was clear for over 250 miles away. I noticed other weather sources saying rain won’t start until 7am  and will last through the afternoon, complete opposite from what Wunderground said. Here I am, and the rain did start around 6:30am, and it will be raining through the afternoon. Currently, Wunderground says it will rain for another 30 minutes and will be stopping, meanwhile we have a huge rain mass coming right towards us. Wunderground.. what happened?

reviews.title: Needs work

Often my weather station disappears from the app for no reason. The app does not show any historical data, not even for the past 24hrs and despite several emails I’ve not had a single response.
